name: Git Technical Practices and Educational Mental Models

children.name: Commits and Diffs
Mental model: save important state and see changes
Link a correction to its specific reason
Avoid remembering only the polished result
Branches
Mental model: keep alternative approaches apart
Test proposals systematically instead of overwriting guesses
Compare different options during analysis
Issues
Mental model: state problem, evidence, and uncertainty
Define clearly what 'done' means
Make precise questioning part of the analysis
Pull Requests and Review
Mental model: offer changes with reasons
Let someone challenge the proposed work
Explain which feedback was accepted, rejected, or deferred
Tests and Reproducible Work
Mental model: make analytical claims checkable
Allow teammates or AI agents to rerun checks
Identify exactly where explanations fail
